acceptanceCriteria: `ticket show <id> --fields body` fails with MALFORMED whose detail names `body`, lists the valid top-level keys, and suggests `record.body`.
Every --fields command shares the same diagnostic; tests cover an unknown key, a valid nested key, and the record.<key> suggestion.
`ticket show --help` (and the other --fields helps) say where ticket fields live (the record. prefix) or list the selectable keys; the owning spec requirement is recorded and traced.
body: Reported in beamfall/corvint#996 (2026-10-16). `corvint-tasks ticket show T --fields body` returns {"codes":["MALFORMED"],"outcome":"ERROR"} with no detail, while `--fields record.body,record.acceptanceCriteria` works. `ticket show --help` only says `--fields KEY[.SUB],...`. Agents try `body`, `description`, `acceptance`, conclude the data is unreadable and stop for an operator. Expected: an unknown --fields key yields an error naming the key, listing the valid top-level keys, and suggesting `record.<key>` when that path exists; help names the selectable keys or the record. prefix. Applies to every command that accepts --fields (ticket list/search/show, queue status, roadmap, attempt show, plan preview). Code: internal/tasks/cli (--fields extraction, command_help.go).
title: corvint-tasks --fields: unknown key returns bare MALFORMED; name the key, list valid keys, suggest record.<key> (beamfall/corvint#996)
